text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Phew~! Really put in the miles today. My 
time was great, too—feeling in top shape.
choice_data_list: Shall we call it a day?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm gonna run just a little bit more. 
My legs are kind of itching to move, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Head on back first, Trainy~!

Midway through summer camp. Hishi Amazon's 
passion for the Shuka Sho and Arima Kinen 
burned bright, and not a day passed 
without voluntary training.

Hishi Amazon's growth is remarkable. It 
felt like she was endlessly approaching 
the "Hishi Amazon" she strived to be. 
However—
(――*beep*)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian! She takes the victory with 
an overwhelming performance!

An overwhelming 5-length victory at the 
wire. In the early summer Japan Derby, 
Narita Brian displayed a monstrous run.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I get stronger with every run. 
Is the Kikuka Sho next? I'm so looking 
forward to it!

Furthermore, the Narita Brian I saw during 
summer camp was—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hah!? What was with that mock race?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Only Brian-senpai is pulling further and 
further ahead... Sheesh, it looks like a 
race between an adult and children.

With a powerful and phenomenal 
performance, she crossed the finish line 
with a lead of over ten lengths.
choice_data_list: （……Is it really okay to stay like this?）

（……I wonder if it's really okay to stay 
like this…）

text_block_list.text:
I suddenly recall some words that Hishi 
Amazon had let slip before.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—I couldn't get the recent one-on-one 
showdown between Brian and the President 
out of my head.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The whole track was electric, quiet, and 
burning with intensity. Everyone watching 
was holding their breath.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And then, I realized it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, as I am right now, there's 
no way I could go head-to-head like that 
against Brian...!

Seeing her display that level of 
frustration was truly shocking.
choice_data_list: (I can't let her make that face again...)

text_block_list.text:
I must make sure this summer training camp 
serves as fuel for Hishi Amazon's growth.

As if in proportion to those anxious 
thoughts... the restless nights continued.
Then, one day.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...? Hey, Trainee-boy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...You've been acting a little strange 
lately. Spacing out, not listening to what 
people say...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If something's bugging you, come talk to 
your big sis about it!

Apparently, it was written all over my 
face without me realizing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure? Looking closely, your 
complexion seems terrible."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Are you sleeping properly? What about 
food? Want me to make something easy on 
the stomach?

I want to avoid doing anything that might 
get in the way of Hishi Amazon's training.

"Hoping to change the subject, I introduce 
some sand beach core training exercises 
that I pulled from my notes yesterday."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, that's weird too. 
Lately, aren't you introducing new 
training menus every single day?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You're, how do I put it... kinda floaty. 
Like you haven't settled down... no, 
that's not quite it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Are you feeling anxious?

I quickly made up an excuse, but Hishi 
Amazon didn't seem convinced... And just 
like that, our training for the day came 
to an end.

The next day. When I went to the beach 
where training was taking place—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Trainy! Today's training is canceled! 
Instead, we're doing a mock race!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I negotiated with the President, and the 
winner gets a year's supply of high-grade 
protein!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And then, well, quite a few good kids 
gathered round. Well... anyway, you just 
watch from over there!!

Made to sit in the shade with an intensity 
that brooked no argument, the practice 
race began.

All 17 Umamusume. Every single one of them 
had already won a graded race.

Right through their midst— Hishi Amazon 
tore ahead with a fiercer drive than 
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ORAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't she... seem even more intense than 
before...? What is that explosive 
speed...?

—Final corner! Hishi Amazon surges up from 
the outside, bursting into the lead with 
incredible momentum!

text_block_list.name: Mock Race Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...! Haaah!

Refusing to back down, two Umamusume 
surged to the front. The pack behind them 
picked up their pace as well. But—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Like hell I'll lose!!

Hishi Amazon sprinted across the sand as 
if flying, pulling away from the rest of 
the pack in the blink of an eye—

She put on a display of overwhelming 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, you always had guts, but... 
didn't you get crazy strong out there?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that really startled me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... How's that, Trainy! Am I still so 
weak that it makes you worry?!

Just as Narita Brian transformed into a 
monster—

Hishi Amazon, having made it through 
spring and summer, had also grown many 
times stronger and tougher.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, finally come to your senses? Don't 
go losing your head, Trainy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I might not look it, but I'm an Umamusume 
who can keep getting stronger and 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And—the one who raised me into who I am 
today is undoubtedly you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So stop overthinking things and stand tall 
and proud!

"Racing is a three-legged race. If you 
don't trust each other, your strides will 
fall out of sync."

It seemed that, somewhere along the way, I 
had completely forgotten the single most 
important thing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, that's my line.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right! That's enough being gloomy! As 
long as you get it, that's what counts, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What're we doing today, Trainy!
choice_data_list: Let's build up even more guts!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nothing wrong with that. Building up your 
body is important!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're already at the beach, how 
about some strength training on this 
unstable sand?"
choice_data_list: Alright, let's give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that we've decided, let's 
start with 500 high knees!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Toryaaaahhh!!

Full of fighting spirit, Hishi Amazon 
worked out at such blistering speed that 
she practically left afterimages.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds good! Come to think of it, I 
found a huge rock earlier.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
How about we pull that and do a whole lap 
around the island?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, that's what I like to hear! 
Alright! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ORAAAAAAAH!! Guts and gloryyyy!

"Along with the giant boulder, she 
vanished beyond the sandy beach in the 
blink of an eye."
